annotations.title: Request repeated human observation over time

description: Request that a human observes something at regular intervals (daily/weekly) over a period and reports what changed, with a dated log and photos. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

interval.description: e.g. daily, every Monday, twice a week.

record_each_time.description: What to record at each observation.

what_to_observe.description: Object, place or process to observe.

name: request_watch_over_time
